findings.before: A remote package fork can have the same vaultId/revision and different ciphertext; revision-only local CAS allowed a stale tab to overwrite it.
findings.fix: Local expected tokens compare vaultId, revision, salt, iv and ciphertext exactly across load/save/export/replace and the UI. Portable envelope schema unchanged.

findings.before: Stopping only the sync controller during pending storage CAS could still write because CAS listened only to the vault lock signal.
findings.fix: replaceForSync sends AbortSignal.any(vault lock signal, sync signal) into storage CAS while preserving vault-session and current-epoch checks.
